name: Rootwell Awakening
description: The Thornveil rootwell's corruption deepens toward permanence: each indecisive Rootmoot and each use of its voices brings it closer to stabilizing as a permanent soul-trap, its trapped dead redefined as 'ancestors.'
triggerEvent: Each Rootmoot that ends without a decision; each use of the well's voices; each season the Abyss incision is left unaddressed.
partialTickEffects: More names spoken, including the living
Soil corruption spreads inward from the well
Passage rites fail further; the dead do not settle
completedEffect: The trap stabilizes as permanent infrastructure; the trapped become 'ancestors'; the soul-flow chokepoint locks and backs up passage for multiple domains; keeper_pressure jumps.
reversalMethods: Cleansing-communion plus Passage-completion (hear via Auralis, Name-Back, release)
Address the Abyss incision at the source

name: Abyss Harvest
description: The Abyss frontier presses the Eastern Thornwall and works to convert the corrupted rootwell into a controlled soul-harvest tap, exploiting Verdance's paralysis to turn the border into a harvest field.
triggerEvent: Each season the Abyss incision is left unaddressed; each rootwell corrupted behind the line; each defender lost to attrition.
partialTickEffects: Soul-harvest infrastructure probes deeper past the wall
Trapped souls feed Abyss power; void_parasitism rises
completedEffect: Abyss secures a controlled soul-flow chokepoint; the Verdance border becomes a permanent harvest tap, backing up the dead of multiple domains and feeding the Keeper.
reversalMethods: Disrupt the Abyss soul-harvest engine beyond the wall
Hold and heal the corrupted rootwells behind the line
Cut the Abyss supply line to the Hollow Pact

name: Heartmoot Paralysis / Exposure
description: The Heartmoot's stagnation deepens as it defers the cure season after season, while the sealed-wells secret strains toward exposure. The council edges toward seal-and-deny for Thornveil rather than admit the cure was feared, not weighed.
triggerEvent: Each Rootmoot that ends without a decision; each move to bury or hide the sealed-wells policy; each reformer driven off.
partialTickEffects: The cure (Heartroot cuttings, a Vigil) stays locked in the capital
Reformers leave in frustration; legitimacy erodes
Pressure builds toward sealing Thornveil and abandoning its dead
completedEffect: The Heartmoot seals and denies Thornveil like the prior three wells, calcifying stagnation into fatalism, or the sealed-wells secret breaks publicly and shatters the council's legitimacy.
reversalMethods: Petition the Heartmoot to release Heartroot cuttings for Thornveil
Break the elders' fatalism and force a decision
Expose the sealed-rootwell secret on terms that compel a cure rather than collapse

name: Othren's Slide
description: Othren Deepbark, the Rootwarden containment officer, has quietly used mild corrupted-sap tricks 'just to hold the line' for a season. Each tolerated shortcut slides him further toward the Hollow Pact's logic and toward becoming a node of the wound he guards.
triggerEvent: Each corrupted-sap tactic used or tolerated at the wall; each time clean containment fails and the shortcut works.
partialTickEffects: Othren rationalizes deeper use of corrupted sap
Trap-residue blight follows his sections of the wall
He begins to defend the wound rather than contain it
completedEffect: Othren fully adopts weaponized rot as doctrine and defects toward the Hollow Pact, normalizing corrupted-sap defense across the frontier and becoming a walking node of the trap.
reversalMethods: Provide a working clean containment alternative
Confront Othren and expose the cost of the shortcut
Relieve the wall's pressure so the forbidden tactic is no longer 'necessary'
